background_story: Handsome was a majestic black stallion with a shiny coat and a proud spirit. He was born into a life of luxury, owned by a wealthy breeder who entered him into prestigious horse shows. However, Handsome's life took a turn for the worse when his owner began to prioritize winning over his well-being. The breeder pushed Handsome to his limits, forcing him to compete despite a nagging injury. The unfair treatment took a toll on Handsome's physical and mental health. One day, he refused to perform, sensing that something was amiss. A kind-hearted groom, who had grown attached to Handsome, discovered the truth and exposed the breeder's cruel tactics. Handsome was finally freed from his miserable life and found a new home with a loving owner who treated him with the care and respect he deserved.
